learning_objective: 🎯 Let us uncover the amazing journey of our food from the farmer's green fields to our yummy lunch plates!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Food does not grow in supermarkets! Hardworking farmers plant seeds, water them, and harvest the crops so we can have fresh vegetables, fruits, and grains.
Our bodies are like incredible machines, and food is the fuel. Chewing well helps our stomach digest the food and pull out special nutrients that make us run faster and think smarter!
Growing food takes a lot of time, water, and love from the earth. We can be Food Heroes by taking only what we can eat and never throwing good food in the bin.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Be a Food Detective!
fun_activity.instructions: Look at your lunch today and try to guess where each part came from. Did the wheat for your roti grow in a field, and did your apple grow on a big tree?

quick_recap: ⭐ Food gives us the magic energy and nutrients we need to grow big, strong, and healthy.
⭐ Farmers work very hard for many months to grow the yummy crops that eventually reach our homes.
⭐ We must respect our food and the people who grow it by never wasting a single bite.
